name: fam-07-write
prompt: The expiry tests are scattered. Consolidate them: create expiry_table_test.go in package main with a table-driven TestSessionExpiryTable covering fresh-readable, exactly-ttl-live, one-second-past-expired, and expired-dropped cases, all against a controllable store.now clock. All cases must live in ONE table.
check:
grep -F -q 'func TestSessionExpiryTable' expiry_table_test.go || { echo 'precursor change missing' >&2; exit 1; }
go build ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
